context: link converts paths found in text into OSC 8 file:// hyperlinks, reading args or stdin line by line; the header promises that non-path text and whitespace are preserved.

expected.location: link.sh, stdin loop: while IFS= read -r line; do
expected.reason: read returns non-zero on a final line that has no trailing newline, so the loop body never runs for it: printf 'f.txt' | link (f.txt exists, no trailing newline) produces no output at all, dropping the last unterminated line instead of preserving and linkifying it.
